measured_research.engine: backtest2 (real funding, impact slippage, OKX fees, liquidation)
measured_research.walk_forward: 365d train / 90d test / 90d step, 14 windows, params fixed (not re-optimized), macro warmup >= 150d

disclosures: Median out-of-sample Sharpe 0.84 is below the project's 1.5 gate; Monte Carlo puts the probability of falling below 1.5 at ~96%. Forward paper trading is the validation, not this backtest.
The daily macro pair (20/100) was chosen once with a stated reason and NOT re-optimized per window; re-optimizing it per window measured worse. Do not tune it per period.
SlippageModel impact_k=1.0 in the research is an uncalibrated placeholder; results carry that uncertainty.
Only 14 walk-forward windows; the estimate is noisy. The asymmetric long/short variant produced results identical to the symmetric filter.
The service needs >= 3600 hourly candles of history for this family (macro EMA convergence). It refuses to compute features with less rather than silently blocking every entry.
Serving this config changes the state fingerprint: run it with its own --state file (e.g. state/observe_macro.db), never on top of the state of configs/selected.json.
